name: Feature Request
description: Suggest an enhancement or new capability for greenify-rea
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: summary
    attributes:
      label: Problem & proposed solution
      description: What workflow or Android API capability should be improved?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: alternatives
    attributes:
      label: Alternatives considered
      description: Any existing Android / Shizuku / Root behavior to keep in mind.
